text: In June 2025 a jury ordered Kroger to pay more than $75 million to an HVAC technician who lost part of both hands after a defective refrigerant exploded while he worked at an Oakland County Kroger store in 2020.

source.name: FOX 2 Detroit – 'Kroger ordered to pay $75M+ to man who lost part of hands while working at Michigan store'
source.quote: A man who suffered severe injuries when a defective refrigerant exploded while he worked at an Oakland County Kroger store will receive more than $75 million from the company.

additionalSources.name: ClickOnDetroit (WDIV Local 4) – 'Oakland County jury awards nearly $77M to man who lost fingers in Kroger chemical explosion'
additionalSources.note: Different publisher from FOX 2 Detroit, but both reports draw on Marko Law's announcement of the verdict; Bloomberg Law, Law360 and The Detroit News also covered it.
additionalSources.quote: an Oakland County jury rendered a record-breaking verdict against the Kroger Company of Michigan
